description: Convert an integer to American-English words, lowercase, space-separated, no 'and'. 0 -> 'zero'. Negative -> 'negative ' followed by the words for the magnitude. Compound tens are hyphenated (e.g. 42 -> 'forty-two'). Uses scale words thousand/million/billion; groups whose value is zero are skipped (e.g. 1000001 -> 'one million one'). Supported magnitude is |n| <= 999999999999; anything larger raises ValueError. Non-int input (including bool) raises TypeError. Pure and deterministic.
constraints: deterministic, pure, no I/O, no randomness, no global state
